import pandas as pd
import sqlite3

# Get hero_ids with Super Strength
conn = sqlite3.connect('db/hero_power.db')
super_strength_heroes_df = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT hero_id FROM hero_power WHERE power_id = 18", conn)
conn.close()

super_strength_hero_ids = super_strength_heroes_df['hero_id'].tolist()

# Read superhero.csv
superhero_df = pd.read_csv('csv/superhero.csv')

# Filter superheroes with Super Strength
super_strength_superheroes = superhero_df[superhero_df['id'].isin(super_strength_hero_ids)]

# Filter for height > 200cm
tall_super_strength_superheroes = super_strength_superheroes[super_strength_superheroes['height_cm'] > 200]

# Count them
count = len(tall_super_strength_superheroes)

print(f'Number of superheroes with Super Strength and height > 200cm: {count}')
